title: Apple's iPhone Duo Faces Screen Cracking Issues
excerpt: Early adopters of Apple's new foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, are reporting issues with screens cracking.
body_html:
A number of early users who purchased Apple's new foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, have reported problems with the device. According to complaints, the screens of the heavily promoted foldable phone are cracking, leaving users dissatisfied with the hardware's durability.

The issue affects a small group of initial buyers who adopted the device early in its release cycle. Apple has not yet provided further details regarding the reported screen defects.
